clues: This is a city in Florida in the United States. It sits east of Tampa.
Summer afternoons often bring thunderstorms here. Winters are quite different, with sun and mild air most days.
It was founded in 1851. Its new name honors the first brigade leader to die in battle in the Civil War.
Locals live near the center of Lightning Alley. Summer storms roll in so often that the name just fits the place.
It sits near the spot where the Peace River starts. That river clue points right to this Florida city.
